constraints: This stage only evaluates review_high_priority candidates for promotion; it never removes a candidate or forces one Picked result per patient.
Reads remain per-test evidence and are never summed across DNA, RNA, or technical repeats.
DNA/RNA agreement or repeated sequencing is one analytical reproducibility axis, not independent clinical confirmation.
Generic group, complex, spp., evidence, and pending-identification labels cannot be promoted as species-level Picked results.
Candida or other respiratory yeast is not promoted without a separately implemented invasive-evidence route.
Imaging is never microbiological confirmation; for PJP it can contribute only when combined with reproducible cross-molecule mNGS evidence.
Host risk alone never promotes an organism; PJP additionally requires reproducible top-three mNGS evidence from a compatible event.
Phenotype, treatment response, WBC, CRP, and outcome do not change deterministic Picked status in this policy.
The policy is answer blind; benchmark answers are used only after output generation by a separate evaluator.
